posts.text: PM @narendramodi is now India's longest-serving elected Prime Minister — surpassing Pt. Nehru's record of 4,399 days. India has summoned the US diplomat over the killing of 3 Indian sailors in US strikes on Iranian-linked vessels. The government stands firm on protecting every Indian citizen abroad.

posts.text: The opposition is creating a false narrative on the new Lok Sabha bills. The country should run not on appeasement, but through equal laws for all citizens. Gujarat's Uniform Civil Code Bill sets the standard — one nation, one law.

posts.text: Three Indian sailors killed in US strikes — and the government stays silent? India's sovereignty and the safety of our citizens abroad cannot be negotiated away for diplomatic convenience. The families deserve answers.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh is setting the national benchmark for law and order, investment, and development. Our commitment to building a New India from the heartland remains unshakeable. The state's industrial corridor is transforming UP's economic future.

posts.text: India is facing a very complicated challenge from China. Our strategy is clear — protect our interests, engage from a position of strength, and never compromise on sovereignty. Diplomacy is about outcomes, not optics.
posts.caption: India is facing a very complicated challenge from China. Our strategy is clear — protect our interests, engage from a position of strength, and never compromise on sovereignty. Diplomacy is about outcomes, not optics.

posts.text: India has doubled its climate spending to 5.6% of GDP. We are proving that economic growth and climate responsibility go hand in hand. Looking forward to presenting India's fiscal vision at the Mindmine Summit on June 15.

posts.text: India's entrepreneurial spirit is its greatest asset. The young generation is building world-class companies right here at home. That gives me immense hope for the future of this nation.

posts.text: India's democracy is its greatest strength, and the Constitution our guiding light. As we build a Viksit Bharat by 2047, every citizen's participation in nation-building is essential. Congratulations to PM Modi on the historic milestone of India's longest-serving elected PM.

posts.text: What they said, including their weak and pathetic statement on having a deal, bears no relation to the truth. Very dishonorable people to deal with. Iran is all talk and no action. The Bully of the Middle East is DEAD!!! We'll bomb the s–t out of them tomorrow.

posts.text: Honoured to represent the United States and our values on the world stage. The strength of this nation lies in its people, their resilience, and the stories that make America exceptional.

posts.text: The FBI's mission is to protect Americans and uphold the rule of law. We are restoring accountability and transparency at every level of the Bureau. No institution is above scrutiny.

posts.text: America's AI policy must be pro-innovation. My role advising the White House is to ensure we stay ahead globally while creating sensible frameworks that let builders build. The US must win the AI race.

posts.text: The World Bank must deliver faster and at greater scale. Climate finance, digital infrastructure, and food security are not separate agendas — they're one integrated challenge for global development. Reform is underway.

posts.text: This Labour government is focused on growth, opportunity, and rebuilding public services. Britain's best days are ahead when we invest in working people and the NHS. That's the mission.

posts.text: Australia's relationship with India is stronger than ever. From critical minerals to education to defence, our partnership is built on shared values and shared opportunity in the Indo-Pacific.
posts.caption: Australia's relationship with India is stronger than ever. From critical minerals to education to defence, our partnership is built on shared values and shared opportunity in the Indo-Pacific.

posts.text: La France accueille le G7 à Évian-les-Bains. Welcoming world leaders for crucial discussions on global security, trade, and the climate transition. Multilateralism must deliver results — this summit will set the agenda.

posts.text: Dubai continues to set the global standard for innovation and connectivity. Our vision is clear: build the city of the future, today. The UAE welcomes the world with open arms and ambitious plans.

posts.text: xAI's Grok 4 is coming soon — the pace of AI progress is insane. Tesla FSD is getting better every single week, the data flywheel is real and accelerating. Meanwhile, Starlink just crossed 5 million subscribers. The future is being built now.

posts.text: Meta is leasing a 168MW AI data centre in Jamnagar, India with Reliance. AI infrastructure is going global. Workforce reduction is inevitable when you need to invest at this scale. And honestly, the AI agent still isn't at a level that can pass the mother test.
posts.caption: Meta is leasing a 168MW AI data centre in Jamnagar, India with Reliance. AI infrastructure is going global. Workforce reduction is inevitable when you need to invest at this scale. And honestly, the AI agent still isn't at a level that can pass the mother test.

posts.text: Google is deeply committed to making AI helpful for everyone. Gemini is transforming Search, Cloud, and Workspace. Building responsibly while pushing the frontier of what's possible — that's our north star.

posts.text: We will quickly lose even the social permission to take something like energy, a scarce resource, and use it to generate these tokens, if these tokens are not improving health outcomes, education outcomes. AI must deliver real, measurable value to society.

posts.text: Expect an OpenAI IPO within the next year. I was pretty wrong about the jobs apocalypse — AI is creating more work than it's destroying, at least so far. New model codenamed 5.6 is coming, and AI budgeting has become a huge issue for some companies.

posts.text: Apple Intelligence is just getting started. We're bringing AI into the devices people use every day — private, powerful, and deeply integrated. WWDC showed the vision; now we deliver it to a billion users.

posts.text: The whole industry supply chain — everything from wafers to packaging to silicon photonics — everything's in short supply because the demand is so high. It is going to persist for several years. The AI revolution needs infrastructure before intelligence.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — is a model for the world. Now we must build the AI layer on top of it to deliver public services at population scale. India has a unique advantage here.
